title: line-B-dequant-family: dequantize_row 族批量 front-door(23 格,共享构造路径一次建,逐格 decode leaf)
description: 线B front-door 化按族批量(复利)。dequantize_row 族 23 dispatch-wired→constructed。族首格建共享 front-door 构造路径(abstract dequantize→typed dequantize region),族内后续格只换 decode leaf。每格 DoD:construct-from-abstract 测试 + 旁路删/六态 flip + byte-exact + [F-EMIT] GREEN。全 construction-only(流式无 tiling)。ledger 按族记边际成本(族首 vs 后续)。触碰集=dequant lowering前门+RVVToEmitCDeferredDequant/RVVToEmitC/RVVToEmitCForwardElementwise+RVVOps.td/WideningOps+lit+ledger(与线C T3 触碰集不相交)。
